chapters.label: Live: EURO 2026
chapters.text: The 2026 Futsal EURO, in Ljubljana. Spain play Belgium. Adrián Rivera is Spain’s fixo, the last defender. After just two minutes, he scores the first goal! Spain win ten to three!

chapters.label: How he does it
chapters.text: Rivera is famous for his poke tackle. Watch how he does it: he stays low and waits. The attacker dribbles at him and takes a big touch. He pokes the ball away with his toe!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Wait, big touch, poke!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: when the attacker pushes the ball too far, poke it away with your toe!
